description: Vega hierarchical treemap of 35 selected platforms in seven families, counting distinct main-game ID–platform pairs released in 1980–2025. A game supported on multiple platforms contributes to multiple rectangles. The CSV contains only family, platform and game_count. The nest and treemap transforms calculate layout coordinates at runtime. Full tooltip names and compact display labels are defined in this specification. The selected counts total 253,355.
